answer: Price identities with a decaying proof-of-time bond: each account locks 95 POA for 30 days and earns back 1 POA per day only if it answers at least 80% of rounds. A farm of 400 sybils must park 38000 POA and run bots through every ocean of rounds, while one ember of downtime burns 5 POA per miss. An honest user with a lantern-sized single node risks under 20 POA a month.
